summary: Charts as layers on the map, the departure runway in your route, and a route that stays drawn while you fly.
releaseNotes: Charts on the map are now layers: turn each one on or off, set its opacity, or remove it, plus Hide charts, Follow aircraft and Full screen.
ChartFox charts can be searched and placed on the map outside the US.
Your route now runs along the departure runway before the SID.
The whole route stays drawn while you fly; your aircraft flies over it.
Connect in the desktop app goes straight to the ChartFox sign-in.
Charts that are not drawn to scale are no longer placed on the map in the wrong spot.
Charts placed on the map are kept, so turning a layer back on is instant.
Your own trail is one dark purple.
The phone tab bar sits lower, right above the home indicator.
